name: SMART EHR launch
description: Starts a SMART App Launch EHR launch of this client application for a patient, and optionally one of the patient's encounters. Only a signed-in user can start a launch, and the same user must then authorize the app. Open the returned url to start the app.

parameter.name: patient
parameter.documentation: The patient the app is launched for. The caller must be able to read it.

parameter.name: encounter
parameter.documentation: The encounter the app is launched in. It must be the patient's, and the caller must be able to read it.

parameter.name: launch
parameter.documentation: The opaque launch value the app passes back at authorization. It expires five minutes after it is created.

parameter.name: iss
parameter.documentation: The FHIR base URL the app is launched against.

parameter.name: url
parameter.documentation: The client's launchUri with iss and launch added to its query. Open it to start the app.
